items.escena: A clay fishing hook dangling just above a row of three small clay listeners who are all leaning toward it
A clay target disc on a stand with a single clay arrow already stuck in its centre
Three clay pillars of equal height standing in a row, each holding up one corner of a flat clay slab
A chunky clay stopwatch whose dial is divided into four coloured wedges, one much larger than the others
A clay figure standing beside an easel while a seated clay listener raises one hand, a small question-mark shape above them
A clay figure practising in front of a tall clay mirror, holding small note cards, with a stopwatch on the floor
A clay desk with small numbered clay cards being laid out in order by a clay hand, a pencil resting beside them
A clay doorway standing open at the start of a short clay path, with a small welcome mat before it
A clay staircase of three broad steps climbing between two small pillars
A clay ribbon tied into a neat bow around a small stack of clay cards
A chunky clay easel holding one large clay picture board, a small clay figure gesturing toward it
A clay speaker figure facing three seated clay listeners, thin clay threads running from its eyes to each of theirs
